column3: BSB follows the critical text with “integrity, dignity”; the Textus Receptus adds a third word, “incorruptibility.” “By doing” is added.
BSB renders “the one of the contrary” as “anyone who opposes us” and follows the critical text with “about us.”
BSB adds “to” and renders “we may live” as “to live … lives.”
BSB renders “the appearing of the glory” as “glorious appearance.”
BSB renders “and exhort and rebuke” as “as you encourage and rebuke.”
